I'd ditch the H55 and use the saved cash to upgrade a few parts. The H55 isn't much better than a 212 EVO.

For ~$20 more, you can get an i5 4460, which adds two cores. Another ~$20 will get you a better SSD; a Transcend S370.

Everything else looks good. Great deal on the RAM and PSU, good monitor and an awesome keyboard (MAXKeyboard FTW). You will have to lower settings in some newer games, playing at 2560 x 1080, but overall it should be fine.

I'm curious why you're liquid cooling a locked i3? Just use the stock cooler, or get a quieter air cooler if you want it super quiet.

Z87 might require a bios update to use a haswell cpu (you need an older cpu for that) so check with your retailer. Z97 would be no hassles.

I would consider either using money saved for an i5, or switching to this one, since you won't be using the better integrated graphics, although it has 1 less mb of cache.

I thought the deal on the PSU was too good to be true but it's because of a rebate I think. Be warned rebates are no guarantee and sometimes it's a huge hassle to get them.

I assume you know how much RAM you need, b/c you could easily drop down to 8 and be fine and save money there.
